topic: SIP in a falling-market month: contributions kept rising while SIP assets fell
core_message: In September 2026 SIP assets fell 4.1%, yet monthly SIP contributions still rose 0.6%.

key_points.text: SIP assets fell 4.1% to 17.86 lakh crore rupees in September 2026, mainly from market-value losses.
Monthly SIP contribution rose 0.6% to 32,490 crore rupees in the same month.
Contributing SIP accounts rose to 10.06 crore from 10.02 crore.

audience: MFD explaining September 2026 SIP data to a worried SIP client
out_of_scope: advice to start or stop a SIP
